reviewer_note: Inspected FRED net-liquidity chart: Fed assets minus TGA minus reverse repos, with unit scaling. Treat as an accounting proxy, not money available to buy stocks or proof of price causation. Components differ in frequency and institutional function.
Inspected dual-axis MVRV Z-score: market/realized cap on log USD axis, Z-score on right. Valuation zones are historical heuristics, not guaranteed floors, ceilings or a cash-flow valuation.

Inspected rolling heatmap: indicators use five-year relative color ranges, newest observations at top; CPI uses a distinct blue/white/red palette. Some series are nominal and need inflation adjustment. A red cell need not mean absolute contraction.
Inspected gold/real-rate dual-axis plot. Opposite visual movement can be useful context but depends on period, axis scaling and regime. Gold is not a mechanical function of a single real-rate series.

Inspected EPD FASTgraphs: operating EPS, historical valuation multiple, selected fair-value multiple, prices and dividends. Future EPS/dividend rows marked E and dotted paths are estimates, not realized results. A normal historical multiple is not an objective intrinsic value.

Inspected global M2: USD-denominated level on left and annual percentage growth on right. Currency translation and changing growth rates matter separately from the level. A rising stock of money does not establish a near-term asset-price prediction.

Inspected China credit impulse/housing plot. Credit impulse is a flow acceleration signal, not the debt stock. Different axes and a small number of historical cycles limit causal inference and lag selection.

Inspected full and 200%-capped scatterplots covering July 2014-July 2023 starting dates. Daily two-year forward returns overlap heavily, so thousands of dots are not thousands of independent tests. A few Bitcoin cycles dominate the sample. The capped panel reveals losses more clearly but cannot establish a valuation floor or correct for changing market maturity; even moderate MVRV values have negative two-year outcomes.
